items.title: John Best interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 15, 1998
items.q: Well this arrangement, Erskine Hawkins played a different line.

ctx.x: Did he write the arrangement, or was it just his tune?

Well this arrangement, Erskine Hawkins played a different line. His was more or less like a 32-bar tune, which is a standard, with a release. This was not quite like that. But it turned out to be a lot of repeats.
Right. Did the — Glenn Miller and all those conductors had to really think about what kind of tempos were going to be good for the dancers, is that right?
